column7: 2026-11-04: {WW} week token must match Excel WEEKNUM(date, 2) (Monday start, week 1 = week containing Jan 1, NOT ISO) because finance's spreadsheets use it. {DDD} (day of year, padded to 3) was added first, uncommitted, for separate review; {WW} builds on it and is still to do. Consider a week-year token since this convention has none.

2026-11-04: {WW} implemented (Excel WEEKNUM(date,2), shares doy helper with {DDD}), tests + readme + d.ts done, all uncommitted. Week-year token deliberately not added yet. Test gotcha: Jan 3 2016 and Jan 3 2021 are Sundays in week 1, not 2.
